description: Land Acquisition - Corrigeuda Notice to the Extra Gazette No. 2016/15 of 25.04.2014 D/S Division, Passara - Bombuwela, Dodangoda D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific notices about acquiring land for public purposes (road improvement project), describes land details (lot numbers, extents, names, claimants), and provides procedures for compensation claims. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisition, property descriptions, and related administrative procedures.
